skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Guides an AI coding agent through a complete implementation plan using critical review, batched execution, verification, and feedback checkpoints.
skill.summary: Execute implementation plans in controlled batches with review and verification checkpoints.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: The only static finding was an unscanned SKILL.zip archive. Manual review showed the archive contains only duplicate prompt-only skill content, with no executable code, credential access, or network behavior found.

remediation.issue: Redundant zipped copy creates a scanner blind spot.
remediation.suggestion: Publish only unpacked skill files, or document that the archive matches the source file.

finding_verdicts.reason: Manual review showed SKILL.zip contains only one SKILL.md file matching the prompt-only skill content. No executable files, hidden payloads, network behavior, or secret access were found.

low_findings.title: Unscanned file (binary) — manual review required
low_findings.confidence_reasoning: Force-confirmed metadata/low static finding; AI dismissal overridden.

content.value_statement: Complex implementation plans can drift without checkpoints and verification. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to review plans, execute batches, verify work, and pause for feedback.
actual_capabilities: Reviews a complete implementation plan before work starts.
Creates a task list and executes the first three tasks by default.
Runs specified verification steps after each task.
Reports completed work and verification output between batches.
Stops for human help when blockers, unclear instructions, or repeated failures occur.
Hands off final branch completion to the finishing development workflow.
limitations: Requires a complete implementation plan before use.
Does not decide product strategy or architecture without human feedback.
Depends on the agent and environment to run requested verification steps.
References a separate finishing workflow that must be available for full completion.

use_cases.title: Implement a reviewed feature plan
use_cases.description: Turn an approved feature plan into completed tasks with verification and review pauses.

use_cases.title: Coordinate agent work across batches
use_cases.description: Keep AI implementation work visible by requiring progress reports after each batch.

use_cases.title: Control risk during refactors
use_cases.description: Execute refactor steps in small groups and stop when verification fails or instructions are unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Run a prepared plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to review this plan, complete the first batch, and report verification results before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Review before implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill. First identify concerns or missing details in the plan, then wait if any issue blocks safe execution.

prompt_templates.title: Execute with checkpoint control
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to execute three tasks at a time, verify each task, and stop for feedback after every batch.

prompt_templates.title: Manage a long implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill for this full implementation plan. Track task state, surface blockers, verify changes, and prepare final branch completion.

output_examples.input: A developer provides a finished plan for a small feature.
output: Plan reviewed with no blocking concerns.
First three tasks completed and verified.
Progress reported for feedback before the next batch.

output_examples.input: A plan step has unclear verification instructions.
output: Execution paused at the unclear step.
The missing verification detail was explained.
A clarification request was sent before more changes were made.
Completed work and verification results were summarized.
The finishing development workflow was requested for final checks.
The user was asked to choose the final completion path.

best_practices: Provide a complete plan with small, verifiable tasks.
Review the first report before approving the next batch.
Keep verification commands and expected results explicit.
anti_patterns: Using the skill with only a vague feature request.
Skipping feedback checkpoints during risky changes.
Continuing after repeated verification failures without clarification.

faq.question: What type of plan works best with this skill?
faq.answer: Use a complete implementation plan with clear tasks, verification steps, and expected checkpoints.

faq.question: Does the skill execute every task at once?
faq.answer: No. It defaults to the first three tasks, then reports progress and waits for feedback.

faq.question: Can it handle blockers during implementation?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the agent to stop when dependencies, unclear instructions, or repeated verification failures block progress.

faq.question: Does it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. The workflow is designed around human checkpoints between task batches.

faq.question: Is this skill only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill is prompt-only and does not include executable code.
